label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — the resolved sink value is the result of `new java.util.Random().nextDouble()` which is attacker-controlled via the initial parameter 'param' that flows into the computation of 'rememberMeKey'. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — the resolved sink value is derived from user-provided values (getValue and getName) that are concatenated into the HTML response without proper encoding, making it vulnerable to XSS. Both alerts are exploitable, driving the case label to TP.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source: new java.util.Random().nextDouble() used to generate rememberMeKey
XSS sink: user-provided values from getName and getValue concatenated into HTML response
